mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports asset valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% month-over-month indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for three consecutive months) signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO above its 3-month moving average) reflects robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth below 50,000 jobs indicates a slowing labor market that constrains consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 50k.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicate a monetary policy response to inflation that reduces equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high rates regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 380,000) supports corporate revenue growth and earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during periods of robust retail activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 380000.
